## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues when applicable.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. State any skipped checks and why.
For schedule changes, include the window, versions, timezone provenance, and evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant checks and limitations are listed above.
- [ ] Tests, documentation, and changelog are updated where applicable.
- [ ] The diff and attached evidence contain no secrets or private data.
